Else: "Contrôle:" owner ("Néant" 4000.6 / "vous" / the player's name) with "Date info:" year; "Pop:" "Inhabitée" (nobody) or "Inconnue" (owned); "Temp:" "%d,%1.1d°C"; "Gravité:" "%d,%2.2dG"; "Métal:" nice number. Your colony: "Revenu: $%s", the population, then the Terra/Mine/Prod bars, or (all terraformed and mined) "En cours:" and the ship queue ("Néant." or one MakeFleetDescription line per queued design). At the bottom "Bataille:" year when a battle was seen there.
rows.how: Decoded @c4334. Rendered unexplored, explored-unowned, explored-owned-by-another and own planets in French and English. Fixed: the unexplored text (remake said "Inexplorée. Envoyez un vaisseau pour en savoir plus."), the population line for planets that are not yours (remake showed "~pop" for another player's colony, which 1.2 never shows: "Inconnue"; and nothing for an unowned planet: "Inhabitée") and the "Pop" label (remake: Population). Gravity, temperature, metal, owner and info date were already the same figures (tools/temp-check.js).
rows.diff: Kept (the remake's panel): "Max population" row and "Construction/Shipbuilding" slider are the remake's own; the queue shows through yardBox (its lines are checked in the DRAWBUILDLISTSHIPBORDER row); the "Bataille:" line is the remake's "Review battle" buttons; the Terra/Mine/Prod vertical bars are the remake's split slider.

rows.shows: The selected fleet's lines: "En recyclage."
